title: Why Chandigarh had no Sector 13 for 50 years, and what Sector 13 is now
description:
Chandigarh's sectors went from 12 to 14 for more than 50 years. The popular story blames Le Corbusier's dislike of the number 13; UT records say the 12 and 13 land was first marked as a cultural zone and 13 never got its own area. In February 2020 the old town of Manimajra was notified as Sector 13.

Sources: The Tribune, 11 Feb 2020; DNA, 12 Feb 2020; Daily Pioneer, 2020. Aerial, plan, town and marker shots are AI visualisation. Photos: Ankit Pai N / Unsplash. Educational content.
